keep_features.feature_value: Positive endorsement of agreement; villain framing in mirror

keep_features.rationale: Original explicitly endorses the agreement as helpful, while the mirror adds alarmist/elite villain language.

keep_features.feature_value: Questions about motives; binary choice ('Are they stupid or...')
